source.label: Cortex XQL
source.query:
preset = xdr_process
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START and agent_os_type = ENUM.AGENT_OS_WINDOWS
| filter action_process_image_path in ("*\mmc.exe") and action_process_image_command_line contains ".msc"
| filter action_process_image_command_line contains "\Users\" or action_process_image_command_line contains "\Temp\" or action_process_image_command_line contains "\ProgramData\"
| filter not (action_process_image_command_line contains "eventvwr.msc /s" or action_process_image_command_line contains "CompMgmt.msc")

targets.label: Sentinel KQL
targets.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FolderPath endswith "\\mmc.exe" and ProcessCommandLine contains ".msc"
| where ProcessCommandLine contains "\\Users\\" or ProcessCommandLine contains "\\Temp\\" or ProcessCommandLine contains "\\ProgramData\\"
| where not(ProcessCommandLine contains "eventvwr.msc /s" or ProcessCommandLine contains "CompMgmt.msc")

notes.msg: The Windows OS condition was dropped: Defender XDR event tables carry no OS column. Results are wider than the source. Join DeviceInfo on DeviceId to restrict by OS.
Cortex ENUM event class (Windows process start events) was rewritten as source DeviceProcessEvents. Event coverage differs between sensors; check that the target collects the same events.
Mapped action_process_image_path → FolderPath (process image path). Path formats differ (device paths, drive letters, case). Check how your sensor records them.

targets.label: Splunk SPL
targets.query:
index=*
| search sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" EventCode=1
| search Image="*\\mmc.exe" CommandLine="*.msc*"
| search CommandLine="*\\Users\\*" OR CommandLine="*\\Temp\\*" OR CommandLine="*\\ProgramData\\*"
| search NOT (CommandLine="*eventvwr.msc /s*" OR CommandLine="*CompMgmt.msc*")

notes.msg: Sysmon events were selected by sourcetype XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational (Splunk Add-on default). Replace index=* with your Sysmon index.
Cortex ENUM event class (Windows process start events) was rewritten as index=* and a selector filter. Event coverage differs between sensors; check that the target collects the same events.
Mapped action_process_image_path → Image (process image path). Path formats differ (device paths, drive letters, case). Check how your sensor records them.

targets.label: CrowdStrike CQL
targets.query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| event_platform = /^Win$/i
| ImageFileName = /\\mmc\.exe$/i and CommandLine = /\.msc/i
| CommandLine = /\\Users\\/i or CommandLine = /\\Temp\\/i or CommandLine = /\\ProgramData\\/i
| not (CommandLine = /eventvwr\.msc \/s/i or CommandLine = /CompMgmt\.msc/i)

notes.msg: Falcon also emits SyntheticProcessRollup2 for processes that started before the sensor. Add it if you need those.

Cortex ENUM event class (Windows process start events) was rewritten as source ProcessRollup2 and a selector filter. Event coverage differs between sensors; check that the target collects the same events.
Mapped action_process_image_path → ImageFileName (process image path). Path formats differ (device paths, drive letters, case). Check how your sensor records them.

targets.label: LogScale
targets.query:
#repo=xdr_process
| event.category = /^process$/i and event.type = /^start$/i and host.os.type = /^windows$/i
| process.executable = /\\mmc\.exe$/i and process.command_line = /\.msc/i
| process.command_line = /\\Users\\/i or process.command_line = /\\Temp\\/i or process.command_line = /\\ProgramData\\/i
| not (process.command_line = /eventvwr\.msc \/s/i or process.command_line = /CompMgmt\.msc/i)

notes.msg: "preset = xdr_process" was carried as a plain source name.
